content:
hannah: Heads-up: Novitas Health invoice INV-9821 failed CC charge — gateway says 'card_declined' with code insufficient_funds. Customer emailed requesting ACH instead to avoid retrying card.
sam: pulling gateway records now. 2 attempts yesterday plus one retry this morning. All rejected with code 'insufficient_funds'.
ravi: their AP team tried to add ACH yesterday but microdeposit returned 'invalid_account' — they might have entered savings vs checking.
billing-bot: Alert: INV-9821 | status: PAYMENT_FAILED | attempts=3 | recommended: contact customer for alternate method or accept wire.
hannah: customer asks if we can accept a wire and confirm immediately to avoid service interruption.
sam: we can accept wire, but note SWIFT wires require beneficiary address match. Our last wire to them bounced due to missing branch ID. I'll generate updated instructions.
ravi: Uploaded wiring docs: https://files.redwood.internal/wires/novitas-instructions-2026.pdf — includes both domestic ACH and wire options.
support-ops: Per policy, account is eligible for billing hold after 3 failures. Do you want to delay hold given they're an active partner?
hannah: I'd prefer a 48h grace for this one while treasury confirms. We should log exception in billing notes.
sam: I can submit a one-off manual retry for card if they insist, but they prefer ACH/wire. Manual retry requires finance approval because it's outside automated schedule.
ravi: For ACH microdeposit, we can initiate a bank-side verification (same-day) for fee $30. Need sign-off to cover this.
support-ops: If we cover fees now, make sure we annotate 'one-time fee covered by Redwood' in memo.
hannah: Approving the $30 for bank verification this time. Add note: future bank fees are customer's responsibility.
billing-bot: Manual actions logged: manual_verification_by_ravi | fee_covered_by=Redwood | timestamp=1857004405
sam: I'll hold off on placing an automatic hold. Flagging CS and infra to avoid feature cutoff while this is pending.
hannah: Remind treasury to include invoice INV-9821 in wire reference and send remittance advice to accounting@redwood.ai.
ravi: Also adding a 4-step checklist to the invoice notes: 1) confirm account type (checking) 2) confirm routing number 3) confirm beneficiary address 4) upload remittance.
sam: If they choose wire we ask them to pdf-scan the remittance and cc billing. If ACH succeeds, we'll clear payment upon microdeposit match.
support-ops: Setting internal reminder for collections review in 9 days.
billing-bot: Reminder scheduled: collections_review for INV-9821 at 1857780000
hannah: Pinged customer's AP. They responded: 'We'll send wire within 24 hours and confirm remittance.'
sam: Great. Once wire is received we'll mark invoice paid and remove pending flags. If wire fails, escalate to collections.
hannah: Closing the loop here; will post update once remittance arrives. :white_check_mark:
